onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

target_on_time.Description: time when the target is shown

go_cue_time.Description: time when the go cue is given

result.Description: trial outcome, R: reward, A: abort, F: fail, I: incomplete

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
